title: Establish the 3.2.5 release-value firewall and pre-candidate planning authority
migration_impact: Cancel C31 candidate-specific release obligations while retaining its product lineage and exact-proposition evidence policy; permit source-bound verification planning for a valid planned reservation without granting candidate authority; hash-verify and isolate the exact development candidate outside immutable historical distribution authority before plan fingerprinting; declare the observed runtime-to-research-cost-domain dependency; render typed work states without misleading unchecked completion boxes; and make execution-registry source metadata portable across LF and CRLF checkouts without changing scenario identities.
release_note_impact: Maintainer documentation distinguishes 3.2.5 release blockers from deferred platform work, planned reservation from exact candidate identity, and incorporated product scope from cancelled C31 candidate obligations.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: apply before source freeze so planning remains available while C32 is only a reserved floor
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: reuse the authority split for future planned target projections without assigning a candidate early
